title: Employment and assignments
description: Maintain effective positions, sites and employment terms without overwriting their history.
adminNotice: Compensation and reasons are administrator-only. These records support operational costing; they are not a certified employment contract or payroll calculation.
managerNotice: Read-only assignments. Compensation and private employment history are restricted to administrators.
forbidden: Only administrators and managers can view employment assignments.

notices.create: Enter the agreed terms explicitly. The position does not grant application permissions. An employee can have only one effective assignment at a time, across all sites.
notices.replace: This closes the previous terms on the new start date and creates new terms for the same employee. The previous pay and the original end date remain preserved.
notices.end: Enter the first day these terms will no longer apply. The new end must be earlier than an existing end. The original evidence remains in history.
notices.void: Use this only to correct an erroneous record, not to end a valid assignment. It stops contributing effective terms but is never deleted. Existing attendance is not changed.

activeSiteRequired: Choose an active site for the new terms.
exclusiveEnd: The employee is not covered by these terms on this date.
optionalEnd: Optional for open-ended terms. If entered, this date is excluded.
preservedEnd: The original end is preserved. Only the remaining period can be replaced.
invalidStart: Enter a valid start date within the remaining period, after the previous start.
invalidEnd: Enter a valid end after the start and earlier than any existing end.
costingNotice: Leave blank when unknown. This estimate is not a legal monthly divisor, overtime entitlement or payroll calculation.
unknownCost: Operational hourly cost unknown — not treated as zero
currencyChanged: Business currency changed from {{from}} to {{to}}. Enter the new amounts explicitly; no currency conversion has been applied.
invalidMoney: Enter a nonnegative amount with at most two decimals, up to 1,000,000,000,000.
reasonMinimum: Explain the change using at least 10 characters.
checkFields: Check the marked fields before saving.
loadError: Employment records could not be loaded.
saveError: Employment terms could not be saved. Keep the form and retry.
empty: No employment assignments match these filters. Administrators can add the agreed terms explicitly.
historyNotice: Restricted evidence. Each change preserves its before and after terms, author and reason. These details are not copied to general audit or remote sync.
